MIDDLESEX COUNTY SHERIFF'S SALE 25001118
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY DOCKET NO. F777524
U.S. BANK TRUST NATIONAL ASSOCIATION, NOT IN ITS INDIVIDUAL CAPACITY BUT SOLELY AS OWNER TRUSTEE FOR RCAF ACQUISITION TRUST, is the Plaintiff, and DARYL S. MARTIN, ET ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged premises dated 12/09/2024.
By virtue of the above stated Writ, to me directed and delivered, I will expose to sale at public vendue on WEDNESDAY, the 25TH DAY of JUNE A.D. 2025, at the hour of one thirty o' clock by the then prevailing (Standard or Daylight Saving) time, in the afternoon of the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Liyingston Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901. The property to be sold is located in the TOWNSHIP OF SOUTH BRUNSWICK, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey
Commonly known as: 73 DEANS LANE, SOUTH BRUNSWICK, NJ 08852, WITH A MAILING ADDRESS OF 73 DEANS LANE, MONMOUTH JUNCTION, NJ 08852
Tax Lot: 20.05, Tax Block: 90.03 Dimensions of Lot: 1.75 AC Nearest Cross Street: BLACKHORSE LANE
Beginning in the center of the raod lead- ing from the New Brunswick and Cranbury Turnpike to the Trenton Turnpike
now known as Dean S Lane, at a point therein distant 369 feet southerly from a corner of lands formerly of Abigail Dumont, said beginning point being also the most southerly corner of a tract of land conveyed by Ann Applegate and Miton Applegate to Vinnocenzo Venza and Sebastana Venza, his wife, by Deed dated September 10, 1936, and recorded in the Middlesex County Clerk's Office in Book 110] of Deeds of Page 300 thence running
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION
PROR LIENS/ENCUMABRANCES
WATER OPEN PLUS PENALTY $294.08 SEWER OPEN PLUS PENALTY $256,74 TOTAL AS OF April 16, 2025: $550.82 Good faith estimate of upset price: $189.807.60
The occupancy status of the property being foreclosed herein is presently unknown.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, includ- ing costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a
motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have Information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the upset to be satisfled by said sale is the sum of ONE HUNDRED SIXTY NINE THOU- SAND FOUR HUNDRED SEVENTY EIGHT DOLLARS AND EIGHTY CENTS ($169,478.80) dollars more or less, plus interest together with the costs of this sale. THE UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS. The subscriber reserves the right to adjourn said sale from time to time subiect only to such limitations or restric- tions upon the exercise of such power as may be specially provided by law or rules of the Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of bid in cash (up to $1,000.00), certified check or official bank check at close of sale and the balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Fein Such Kahn Shepard PC 6 Campus Drive Suite 304
Parsippany, NJ 07054
Aftorneys
